$comment: Generated from tokens.css by `bun run tokens:generate`; do not edit. Set these on an element with class nc-root (or an ancestor). light and dark are the defaults used when a name is unset.

tokens.name: --nc-border
tokens.meaning: Border colour of panels and controls.

tokens.name: --nc-accent
tokens.meaning: Action colour; also the focus ring unless --nc-ring is set.

tokens.name: --nc-danger
tokens.meaning: Colour of errors and destructive actions.

tokens.name: --nc-radius
tokens.meaning: Corner radius of panels and controls.

tokens.name: --nc-font-sans
tokens.meaning: Text font family; unset, the module inherits the host's.

tokens.name: --nc-accent-fg
tokens.meaning: Text on the accent colour (primary Button, selected Tabs item).

tokens.name: --nc-danger-fg
tokens.meaning: Text on the danger colour (destructive Button, solid Alert).

tokens.name: --nc-surface
tokens.meaning: A raised surface (Card, Dialog, Tooltip); defaults to --nc-bg, the border separates it.

tokens.name: --nc-subtle
tokens.meaning: A quiet surface (Skeleton, Tabs track, DataTable row hover, neutral Badge); defaults to a low-contrast mix of --nc-fg into --nc-bg.

tokens.name: --nc-success
tokens.meaning: Success colour (Badge, Alert); the default meets WCAG AA on --nc-bg.

tokens.name: --nc-warning
tokens.meaning: Warning colour (Badge, Alert); the default meets WCAG AA on --nc-bg.

tokens.name: --nc-font-mono
tokens.meaning: Monospace font family (code Input, code and JSON blocks).
